disposability.rationale: Переписывается за час по контракту: прочитать tasks.route; дела (не question/assessment) пачками по 8 — send(kind=task) ассистенту; неотвеченные в бот дольше tasks.nudge_after_days — пометить followup_sent_at и один send(kind=nudge).
disposability.oracle: tests/unit/test_task_route.py: без хука в task_agent красный test_assistant_route_hands_over_deeds_not_questionnaires (прогон 07.11).

contract.overdue: overdue_assistant_tasks reads tasks.assistant_overdue_grace_days (single fallback 2, whole days >=0) and tasks.assistant_no_deadline_days (single fallback 14, whole days >=1). Only assistant route, open handed-over deeds, followup_sent_at NULL. ISO deadline date is evaluated after end of UTC day plus grace; without deadline, elapsed time since first hand_over request must exceed waiting days. Ack and replies do not affect eligibility; any task closure excludes it.
contract.delivery: Existing task_nudge_job groups dated/undated deeds with separate i18n captions; task_agent.format_open_tasks_message + task_keyboard + send_long, batches <=20. Tenant-local task_overdue.lock. Mark followup only after all receipt IDs; log count, no fault for overdue deeds. Actual config/storage/transport errors still journal faults. Nudge failure does not block fallback.
contract.limits: Legacy requests lack task_ids, so explicit backfill is required. No exactly-once guarantee across Telegram/SQLite crash or ambiguous acknowledgement. No new bridge protocol or schema.

followup_policy.reason: hypothesis_resolution._create_task_if_needed and dashboard confirm copy payload.test into followup. handlers.tasks completion and tasks_db.resolve_task do not require a conversational answer for this type. GP followup is an overloaded label, not sufficient evidence of a return-address contract.
